# Bayes FC

> Football power rankings from the betting market: daily attack, defence, and overall strength ratings for Europe's top football clubs, derived from closing betting-market prices and rebuilt every day.

Bayes FC publishes market-based football power rankings for 7 European leagues: every club on one cross-league scale, plus a table per league, updated daily.

## Ratings

- [Global cross-league ladder](https://bayesfc.com/): Market-based football power rankings: every European club on one comparable strength scale, rebuilt daily from betting-market closing prices.
- [League ladders](https://bayesfc.com/leagues.html): Football power rankings for each of Europe's top leagues: daily attack, defence and overall strength ratings for every club, derived from closing betting-market prices.
- [Club pages](https://bayesfc.com/club/): one page per rated club — its rating over time, recent results, upcoming fixtures and season projection (132 clubs).

## Questions

- [Who is the strongest team in Europe?](https://bayesfc.com/strongest-team-in-europe/): As of 30 September 2026, the market rates Arsenal the strongest club in Europe, ahead of Manchester City and Barcelona.
- [Which is the strongest league in Europe?](https://bayesfc.com/strongest-league-in-europe/): As of 30 September 2026, the Premier League is the strongest league in Europe by the average rating of its clubs, ahead of La Liga and Ligue 1.
- [Which league has the most open title race?](https://bayesfc.com/most-open-title-race/): As of 30 September 2026, Serie A has the most open title race, with 3.5 effective contenders, ahead of the Eredivisie (3.3) and the Primeira Liga (2.8).
- [Who will win the Premier League this season?](https://bayesfc.com/premier-league/title-race/): As of 30 September 2026, the Premier League title race has 2.5 effective contenders, unchanged this week. Manchester City is the most likely Premier League champion at 49%, ahead of Arsenal (47%) and Liverpool (3%).
- [Who is the strongest team in the Premier League?](https://bayesfc.com/premier-league/strongest-team/): As of 30 September 2026, the market rates Arsenal the strongest side in the Premier League, ahead of Manchester City and Liverpool.
- [Who will be relegated from the Premier League this season?](https://bayesfc.com/premier-league/relegation/): As of 30 September 2026, the Premier League relegation race has 8.0 effective clubs in danger, unchanged this week. Hull is the most likely to be relegated from the Premier League at 75%, ahead of Coventry (72%) and Ipswich (42%).
- [Who will win La Liga this season?](https://bayesfc.com/la-liga/title-race/): As of 30 September 2026, the La Liga title race has 1.6 effective contenders, unchanged this week. Barcelona is the most likely La Liga champion at 84%, ahead of Real Madrid (16%) and Atletico Madrid (1%).
- [Who is the strongest team in La Liga?](https://bayesfc.com/la-liga/strongest-team/): As of 30 September 2026, the market rates Barcelona the strongest side in La Liga, ahead of Real Madrid and Atletico Madrid.
- [Who will be relegated from La Liga this season?](https://bayesfc.com/la-liga/relegation/): As of 30 September 2026, the La Liga relegation race has 9.7 effective clubs in danger, unchanged this week. Malaga is the most likely to be relegated from La Liga at 68%, ahead of Elche (43%) and Santander (35%).
- [Who will win Serie A this season?](https://bayesfc.com/serie-a/title-race/): As of 30 September 2026, the Serie A title race has 3.5 effective contenders, unchanged this week. Inter is the most likely Serie A champion at 59%, ahead of Roma (17%) and Juventus (11%).
- [Who is the strongest team in Serie A?](https://bayesfc.com/serie-a/strongest-team/): As of 30 September 2026, the market rates Inter the strongest side in Serie A, ahead of Juventus and Roma.
- [Who will be relegated from Serie A this season?](https://bayesfc.com/serie-a/relegation/): As of 30 September 2026, the Serie A relegation race has 8.3 effective clubs in danger, unchanged this week. Parma is the most likely to be relegated from Serie A at 69%, ahead of Monza (49%) and Lecce (44%).
- [Who will win the Bundesliga this season?](https://bayesfc.com/bundesliga/title-race/): As of 30 September 2026, the Bundesliga title race has 1.2 effective contenders, unchanged this week. Bayern Munich is the most likely Bundesliga champion at 97%, ahead of Dortmund (2%) and Leverkusen (–).
- [Who is the strongest team in the Bundesliga?](https://bayesfc.com/bundesliga/strongest-team/): As of 30 September 2026, the market rates Bayern Munich the strongest side in the Bundesliga, ahead of Dortmund and Leverkusen.
- [Who will be relegated from the Bundesliga this season?](https://bayesfc.com/bundesliga/relegation/): As of 30 September 2026, the Bundesliga relegation race has 7.9 effective clubs in danger, down 0.1 this week. Union Berlin is the most likely to be relegated from the Bundesliga at 43%, ahead of Paderborn (41%) and M'gladbach (33%).
- [Who will win Ligue 1 this season?](https://bayesfc.com/ligue-1/title-race/): As of 30 September 2026, the Ligue 1 title race has 1.3 effective contenders, unchanged this week. Paris SG is the most likely Ligue 1 champion at 95%, ahead of Monaco (3%) and Lille (1%).
- [Who is the strongest team in Ligue 1?](https://bayesfc.com/ligue-1/strongest-team/): As of 30 September 2026, the market rates Paris SG the strongest side in Ligue 1, ahead of Lens and Monaco.
- [Who will be relegated from Ligue 1 this season?](https://bayesfc.com/ligue-1/relegation/): As of 30 September 2026, the Ligue 1 relegation race has 7.3 effective clubs in danger, unchanged this week. Le Havre is the most likely to be relegated from Ligue 1 at 52%, ahead of Le Mans (37%) and Troyes (35%).
- [Who will win the Primeira Liga this season?](https://bayesfc.com/primeira-liga/title-race/): As of 30 September 2026, the Primeira Liga title race has 2.8 effective contenders, up 0.1 this week. Benfica is the most likely Primeira Liga champion at 47%, ahead of Porto (37%) and Sp Lisbon (16%).
- [Who is the strongest team in the Primeira Liga?](https://bayesfc.com/primeira-liga/strongest-team/): As of 30 September 2026, the market rates Benfica the strongest side in the Primeira Liga, ahead of Sp Lisbon and Porto.
- [Who will be relegated from the Primeira Liga this season?](https://bayesfc.com/primeira-liga/relegation/): As of 30 September 2026, the Primeira Liga relegation race has 7.2 effective clubs in danger, unchanged this week. Casa Pia is the most likely to be relegated from the Primeira Liga at 58%, ahead of Rio Ave (33%) and Nacional (33%).
- [Who will win the Eredivisie this season?](https://bayesfc.com/eredivisie/title-race/): As of 30 September 2026, the Eredivisie title race has 3.3 effective contenders, unchanged this week. PSV Eindhoven is the most likely Eredivisie champion at 60%, ahead of Feyenoord (18%) and Twente (8%).

Willem II is the most likely to be relegated from the Eredivisie at 79%, ahead of Cambuur (57%) and Den Haag (32%).

## Writing

- [Who got the easy start? First five games in England, Spain and Germany](https://bayesfc.com/blog/fixture-difficulty-opening-five.html): Every club's first five league games in the Premier League, La Liga and the Bundesliga, ranked from the hardest opening to the easiest.
- [What a wage bill buys](https://bayesfc.com/blog/what-a-wage-bill-buys.html): Across Europe's top seven leagues, pay explains most of team strength — but the clubs off the line are the interesting ones.
- [How we turn betting odds into team strength](https://bayesfc.com/blog/how-we-turn-betting-odds-into-team-strength.html): Why betting odds tell you more about a team than results or xG — and how we read team strength straight out of them.
